verdicts.reason: In A, the cream circle has come loose from the product and slid into the bottom-left corner. That leaves the orange can sitting on the orange background, where it is almost invisible, so the key product image is effectively lost. B keeps the circle behind the can, so the product reads. Both share the same flaws: the NEW badge and the Try It button are squeezed together at the far-right edge, apart from the text column; the body copy is oversized and leaves 'now.' alone on its own line; and the badge and CTA float at mid-height instead of following the text in reading order.
